records.scope: Flask application implementing the superlawyers.com mirror: consumer homepage (hero lawyer search, Why Super Lawyers, legal-issue cards, resource topic cards, Ask a Lawyer spotlight, for-lawyers band), attorney directory (national hub with the 19-category practice taxonomy, state and city pages, practice x city SERPs with lawyer cards, related practice areas, nearby cities, intro copy, FAQ accordions, court locations), lawyer and firm profile pages (sidebar summary, practice-area percentage pie chart, achievements, office, contact form), Top Lists (hub with the 40 upstream regions, state pages, list detail pages), legal article resources (hub, topic overviews, articles, scored search), Ask a Lawyer (hub with spotlight answers and topic/state taxonomy, Q&A detail pages, scored search), attorney feature articles, static pages (about, selection process, attorney FAQ, for-lawyers, digital magazines, marketing solutions, contact), and the account area (register, login, profile edit, favorites, saved searches, inquiries).

Deterministic build-time seeder. All content rows come from the tracked source_data/ snapshots captured from the live site; lawyer photo variants are resolved from the on-disk asset bundle; benchmark users use a frozen bcrypt digest so the SQLite seed is byte-reproducible on every build (PYTHONHASHSEED=0).
